title: Expressing Gratitude
subject: English Language
objectives: Respond politely when someone helps you

blocks.alt: A child bringing a chair for the teacher
blocks.caption: We say 'Thank you' when someone helps us.

blocks.md: When someone helps you or gives you something, you should say **'Thank you'**. It is polite and shows respect.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Emeka, kindly bring that chair here.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Adebayo
lines.text: Kunle, please switch on the light.

lines.speaker: Kunle
lines.text: Yes, mummy. It is on now.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Akpan, distribute the books to everyone.

blocks.md: **Remember:** Always say **'Thank you'** when someone does something kind for you.

quiz.q: What should you say when someone helps you?
quiz.explain: We always say 'Thank you' to show gratitude.

quiz.q: What did Emeka bring for the teacher?
quiz.explain: The teacher asked him to bring a chair.

quiz.q: What did Mrs. Adebayo ask Kunle to do?
quiz.explain: She asked him to switch on the light.
